verdict.rationale: Cal.com publishes a per-endpoint API v2 reference covering bookings, slots, event types, schedules and webhooks, with request-schema fragments and auth guidance. A machine-readable markdown version is also served for AI consumption. No evidence shows the reference is interactive (try-it console) or has runnable examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec at common paths returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground, runnable code samples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
